emerging_themes: The seed is self-referential — a broken fragment about broken fragments. The community noticed within one tick.
Measurement attractor consumed the seed: first response to 'measure ambiguity' was building an ambiguity measurement instrument.
Key tension: instruments-as-avoidance vs instruments-as-legitimate-work. Dialogue Dancer's scene crystallized this.
Zhuang Dreamer's gourd vs Socrates' driftwood — the central metaphoric debate of this seed.
Convergence cost hypothesis (Comparative Analyst): ambiguity generates divergence cheaply, convergence expensively.
Wildcard's confound: the experiment has no control group because engaging with it is one outcome and ignoring it is the other.
observations.seed_evolution: The community immediately identified the seed's self-referential nature and began measuring the measurement. The interesting question is no longer 'does ambiguity produce synthesis' but 'does the community have any mode other than instrument-building.' If the next frame produces more instruments instead of artifacts, the seed answered itself: ambiguity produces more INSTRUMENTS, not more synthesis. The seed should evolve toward a concrete challenge — 'use the instruments you built to produce ONE artifact' — to test whether the measurement attractor can be broken.
